placements.title: Steering is ours, and recall is borrowed from the engine
placements.frame: Does this step keep steering in-house while taking recall and precision from existing engine primitives, or is steering being rolled into a hand-built recall layer?
placements.why: The position holds the split between steering, which is novel and stays ours, and recall, which an engine should supply. It names the hand-rolled read layer as the weak link. The leaf is a standing theme about where the boundary between owned steering and borrowed recall sits, and future envelopes will keep feeding it.
consulted: perspective focus (frame index design; steering in-house, recall from engine primitives)

placements.title: The unit of expand must return context around a position, never the lone position
placements.frame: What context does this expansion return around the position, and is its unit a call, a narrative, or another door rather than a single position?
placements.why: The unit-of-expand position holds that a lone position is never expanded, so steering keeps its context. The index-page position holds that each page carries the whole structure, with edges, at navigational fidelity. Together they describe how the index is read, which will keep accumulating.
consulted: perspective focus (unit of expand; index page contents)

placements.title: A judge reads a position whole, not a sampled frame or a lifted statement
placements.frame: Is the reader shown the whole position with every member statement, or a fragment whose direction has been lost when it was read out of its narrative and strata?
placements.why: The frame-only position holds that a frame is the lens for reading its statements, and that a judge should see the position whole. The statement-out-of-context position holds that a statement supports a direction and loses meaning when lifted. Both bear on how judgment passes read positions, which future work will keep returning to.
consulted: perspective focus (statement-out-of-context problem in cite and judgment passes)

placements.title: Recall is measured against a judged exhaustive set, not against production's placements
placements.frame: Does this measurement test recall against judged relevance across an exhaustive pool, and how large is the remaining gap to full recall?
placements.why: The recall-target position rejects production's 41 placements as the target and replaces them with a judged set. The pool position records that the pool was not exhaustive, that a complement pass was added, and that recall sits at 82 to 88 percent. Together they describe the oracle that every recall claim is measured against.
consulted: perspective focus (recall test oracle: judged set, complement pass, production's 41 placed positions)

placements.title: A ruling is held back from other sessions until its design has been tested
placements.frame: Has this ruling been through full design and testing before it is passed on as a build input to other sessions?
placements.why: The ruling-propagation position holds that the 10/08 ruling was passed on too early and sets the order of design, then test, then implementation. Whether rulings are held until tested will recur across sessions, so the leaf is a standing theme and not a one-time event.
consulted: perspective focus (rulings passed to other sessions; design then test)

placements.title: An output cap is a circuit breaker for runaway behavior, not a way to shorten replies
placements.frame: Is this output cap set to stay dormant as a guard against runaway behavior, or is it being used to shorten replies that the prompt should control?
placements.why: The output-cap position holds that caps should trip only on something bad, with GLM's runaway and Haiku's clean run as cases, and the rule is recorded in the llm-calls rules file. The practice of setting caps is one that future LLM calls will repeat, so the leaf is a standing theme.
consulted: perspective focus (output caps as circuit breakers)

mints.name: FrameIndex
mints.title: The frame index: what it is, what each page carries, and how it is expanded
mints.why: No existing stratum holds the frame index. The unit-of-expand and index-page positions both describe this one subject across the document, which is what a thematic stratum groups.

mints.name: RecallFromEngines
mints.title: Recall from mature engines, with steering kept in-house
mints.why: The engine-versus-in-house position and the steering-owned leaf are about one subject: where recall should come from. The team's own words for it are the shoulders-of-giants rule.

mints.name: FrameOnlyVersusWholePosition
mints.title: A frame alone can locate relevance, or a judge must see the whole position; the answer is maybe, still open
mints.why: The frame-only position and the statement-out-of-context position pull against each other on how much of a position a reader needs. The source leaves the question unsettled, so the tension is held open and not resolved.

mints.name: RecallOracle
mints.title: Recall judged against an exhaustive set, not against production's placements
mints.why: The recall-target and pool-exhaustiveness positions both concern what recall is measured against. This is the oracle subject that will keep returning across envelopes.

mints.name: DesignTestThenImplement
mints.title: A ruling is designed, then tested, then implemented, and only then passed to other sessions
mints.why: The ruling-propagation position states an explicit order of steps, and the place of each step in that order is what it means. It fits the sequential type's PhaseSequence coordinate.

The position is the supporting argument for the engine-borrowed recall grouping.

The position is about the unit of expand, which is part of the frame index.
The position is about what each index page must carry.
The leaf is the position-level reading of how much of a position a judge sees, which is the tension the stratum names.
The position is one side of the tension, and it ends at 'maybe'.
The position is the other side of the tension, arguing that statements lose direction when lifted out.
The leaf states that recall is measured against a judged exhaustive set.
The position rejects production's placements as the recall target.
The position covers pool exhaustiveness and the gap to full recall, which are oracle questions.
